name: flightbridge-plugins
description: FlightBridge for FBOs and for aircraft operators: the FlightBridge connector and the skill for your business.

plugins.name: flightbridge-test-for-fbos
plugins.description: For FBO customer service reps: put visiting aircraft on the schedule, answer rate questions from your location's rate card, and book hotel rooms and rental cars for visiting crews through your FlightBridge account.

plugins.name: flightbridge-test-for-operators
plugins.description: For flight departments, charter schedulers and Trip Managers: plan trips and legs in a sentence, and book crew hotel rooms and rental cars through your FlightBridge account.
